continuously reloaded 3,000-atom machine

Harvard / MIT

continuously reloaded 3,000-atom machine

Harvard / MIT · neutral atoms · DEMONSTRATED (Sep 2025 (Nature 646, 1075; arXiv Jun 2025)) · 3000 physical qubits · access: lab-only
architecture: מערך פינצטות רידברג — אלקליים (Rb/Cs) · Open on the map

Register profile — the machine's variant of its architecture

qubit type: hyperfine clock-state qubit
gate mechanism: no entangling result in this paper - the machine is a continuous-operation enabler
connectivity: defect-free arrays of 2,024 atoms within 60 ms; two optical-lattice conveyor belts move atoms ~0.5 m, AOD tweezers only for local rearrangement; reload 300,000 atoms per second giving 30,000 initialised qubits per second
control: SLM tweezers, conveyors and Rydberg lasers
control placement: optics (room temperature)
readout: fluorescence imaging
flags: enabler only
